book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Qateiv iingama veil

Woyom Yesu ghanaw beyeeng tiyon me la eivek tembuing danghei tiwei Yudia nei me la Yorodan veweeng aning. Xomaxoneing qendu ngandoung mi lam wou Yesu no om di teyoxe xel nambei e xe kwa wei e mi teyoxe xel o.
Parisi valu lam me wo axeing wou e om xel teling, “Beip inyei petieing lenghek bei moux qateiv iingama wei luw venei yo veil o ma?”
E neil elox, “Mose wong qayeeng petieing vati wou xam?”
Xel neil, “Mose lenghek lek bei moux a byex qapiya wei qateiveing iingama veil dom bong vex on na.”
Yesu neil elox, “Inyon Mose byex petieing tine wou xam en inye nambei xam laleimim on wo nikanzek.
Ekom eivek myaxeeng selis wei toung tembuing is tyoung eno ‘Anutu toung xomaxoneing valu moux de valu vex.’
‘En qes tine moux tyek na veil ma luw ta de luw venei na toung lekti,
me tyek luw xouing bo neing tixemou.’ Om luw se wo yuw no qe neing tixemou.
Nambei nyon vati wei Anutu tendulekti, eno moux ti se qateiv.”
Gyeik xel toundei eivek xomek no, eno xel betiyeing teling Yesu en tine.
E lewexe, “Tambiy ti qateiv iingama wei luw venei yo veil, dom dii vex nge no, ond wong kwapesiv wei inye la sewok wou venei.
De wangwei vex on qateiv iingama wei luw leya yo veil, dom mendei wou moux nge ond vex on wo kwapesiv.”
Yakyak me Yesu
Xel xomaxoneing on di qou yakyak me lam wou Yesu bei e niw mema lek xel, ekom xel betiyeing neil xel.
Gyeik Yesu yei tine, moxo lalei wo vanei om neil wou xel, “Wong yakyak on lam wou ay. Xam se zeimaxoun xel, en tete lalei wei Anutu xe yo inye xel yakyak ambei nye xe.
A neil wou xam zonghek, tambiy ti se teyei bei na eivek tete lalei wei Anutu xe yo wangwei e se ghok xel yakyak wei leind maeing ne.”
Om moxo qava yakyak on eivek mema me liw mema lek xel dom wo mata wou xel.
Moux ghavis wei lulul ana yo

Ka Yesu di la wou sakwaing, moux ti veimya me la wou e me ev vaxa qatu eivek wou e. Moxo teling, “Putoung nimza, a bong vati en na qou mapieing luta luta wei Mang Anutu neil zonghek bei bong wou neuyeiw loxyus o?”
Yesu neil elox, “Nambei nya wang taxe ay nimza? Xelti se nimza qe Anutu venaxow.

Wang woulek qayeeng petieing ne woy: ‘Wa seng nyeis xelti na mey, wa seng bo kwapesiv, wa se panax, wa seng bo qayeeng tyonyeing me ghe bo qayeeng en xel nge, wa seng bong tyonyeing me tetei xel nge xe lulul, wa mi sanghoxe mam aluw tam.’ ”
E neil e lox wou e, “Putoung, qayeeng ti beimambei ne dalus eno a mi betiwou gyeik ingwei a yak o.”

Yesu yei e me lalei vind e. Moxo neil, “Wang ma en lul tika. La me wo vateivek lek lul dalus wei wang o de wong malew wou xel kanyo, on tyek wa qou lulul nimzamza eivek tyoung gheyapu. Dom lam betiwou ay.”
Moxo ngo qayeeng tine om yei manol. De la is lalei maying en nambei e xe lulul ngenongakes.
Yesu pekwi ma wou e xe xel betiyeing me neil wou xel, “Inye wo pok en xomaxoneing wei lulul ana embei na eivek tete lalei wei Anutu yo!”
Xel betiyeing etek en e xe qayeeng. Ekom Yesu neil no, “Xam neungyeiw, inye wo pok en ingwei laeing eivek tete lalei wei Anutu yo!
Inye wo pok en ingwei kamel embei na nox ying manghalus wei duweing lul en o, nambei nyon eno moux wei lulul ana eno inye wo pok ngandoung en ingwei embei na eivek tete lalei wei Anutu xe yo.”
Xel betiyeing etek ngandoung, me neil wouma, “Wangwei nambei nyon nei, on tyek eti na eivek Anutu xe tete lalei?”
Yesu yei xel bombek me neil, “Is xomaxoneing eno xel se teyei, ekom se nambei nyon is Anutu. Anutu teyeimbei bong lulul dalus.”
Petele neil wou e, “Wei, xa ghanaw xa xe lulul sapa dom na betiwou wang o!”
Yesu neil elox, “A neil zonghek wou xam, xel eti yeiw wei ghanaw bend o liyeiw moux o liyeiw vex o tayeiw o neuyeiw o xuk yaeing en ay me Xoulek Nimza ne,

de tyek xel a qou 100 lek mapu eivek bouk tine, me tyek xel a qou xomek ngenong, liyeiw moux, liyeiw vex, tayeiw, neuyeiw, me xuk yaeing ngenong, me tyek xel bo nol wou xel is de tyek loxyus eno xel a qou mapieing luta luta.
Ekom xel ngenong wei tax eno tyek nox yus dom xel wei loxyus eno natax.”
Yesu lox me la neil teyei no en e xe meyeing

Xel di la wou sakwaing me la pu Yerusalem nei, me Yesu la mamunghexeing, de xel betiyeing eno di wou naleind ngenong me xel wei mi betiwou eno yaleeng. De qou xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw no me la nenyawes me neil wou xel en vati wei tyek nam belup wou e yo.

Moxo neil, “Wei, xey a bei na pu wei Yerusalem nei me tyek xel a neil Xomaxoneing Neu Moux teyei me na toung eivek xel lumuki leitata me putoung wei petieing o memend. Tyek xel bo qayeeng en e me natup qayeeng en embei nyeis e mey de bong e na wou xel amba,
wei tyek xel baluk yak lek e me pesuv myenlouk lek e, me sesa embo nol me nyeis e mey. Ka bouk yal nak veil moxo tyek qandi lek.”
Telinyeing wei Jems me Yoan o
Woyom Sebedi neu moux a luw lam wou e. Luw neil, “Putoung, uw ambei wang bong vati wei uw ambei teling wang en eno wou uw.”
Moxo teling, “Inye muw ambei am bong vati wou muw?”
Luw neil elox, “Gyeik wa mendei lek wa xe siaking is wa leim ngandoung, yon wong uw nge dei wou wa memam payeiv de nge mendei wou wa memam qeinz.”
Yesu neil, “Muw seng woulek vati wei muw ghe di teling en o. Muw ghe teyeimbei tyek na num eivek mayamya wei a num eivek o de muw ghe teyei bei zipek is lipekeing wei a lipek en ne?”
Luw lewexe, “Uw teyei.” Yesu neil wou luw, “Tyek muw teyei bei num eivek mayamya wei a num eivek ne, me ghe zipek is lipekeing wei a lipek is o,
ekom ingwei deing wou a memang payeiv o qeinz inyon se wou ay bei a zenghek lek. Beyeeng beimambei ne inye wou xel wei Anutu menyex woy wou xel o.”
Gyeik ingwei xel xoumeeng on ngo qayeeng en tine, xel laleind wo vanei wou Jems me Yoan.

Yesu taxe xel xouing lam wou e me neil, “Xam ghe woulek bei inyon eti yeiw wei xel yei bei inyei gyovaxa wei xel amba wei mi wo nikanzek lek yeing xel teyei, me xel wei wo lunkanzek en xel amba eno mi yeiteyei xel wo nikanzek.
Ekom se nambei nyon is wou xam. Qe eti yeiw wei embei bong lei ngandoung eivek xam senghoing, ond e mi bong ambei xam xe xukxe,
me eti yeiw embei na mamunghexeing eivek xam senghoing ond embong ambei xukxe bandaing wei xel dalus o.
En Xomaxoneing Neu Moux se lam bei xomaxoneing bo xuk wou e me devind e qe lam bei bong xuk me devind xomaxoneing ngenong me bong mapieing wei e yo nambei malew me na bey xel ngenong.”
Batimius wei matekeing eno ma yeila

Woyom xel lam Jeriko. Ka Yesu is e xe xel betiyeing, is xel qendu ngandoung on xel xouing lam veil beyeeng on me la eno matekeing ti lei Batimius inyon Timius neu moux toundei wou sakwaing nenyawes me tay lulul wou xel.
Gyeik e ngo bei inyon Yesu wei Nasaret o, moxo taxe bei, “Yesu Dawit Neu Moux, wa laleim e pyaxow en ay!”
Xel ngenongakes luk nikanzek wou e me neil wou embei denduing ma, ekom moxo taxe no niseikeing bei, “Dawit Neu Moux, wa laleim e pyaxow en ay!”
Yesu nale me neil, “Taxe e lam.” Om xel taxe la wou moux matekeing on, “Wang bo xeimlala dom bale lek vaxam! En moxo taxe wang o.”
Moxo nex e xe teimb ding nge mapu teila nenyawes, dom vyeip me la wou Yesu.
Yesu teling e, “Wambei a bong vati wou wang?” Moux matekeing neil, “Putoung, ambei gheina yo.”
Yesu neil, “La, wa xe wongeingis wong wang wo nimzalek.” Lutika eno moxo ma yeila dom betiwou Yesu me tupwou sakwaing.
